meta.source: Nathan directive 2026-10-15: 'I want languages consolidated and new names being made with better labeling for what it does and why it was made too. This needs to start looking different over time.'
meta.note: 28 bodies -> 18. Sovereign family untouchable. New names synthesized from parent primitives (rustgemba pattern). Every body labeled: name / what it does / why it was made.

consolidation.hard_rule: Nathan's sovereign family stays distinct and untouchable: Gemba, Rustba (root name 'Rust' in the mandala), Lavemba, tRust, Dentauri.

families.name: Lavaweave
families.etymology: lava (molten flow) + weave (making) — the molten loom

families.name: Malbrain
families.etymology: mal (pain, from Malbolge) + brain (the minimal machine, from Brainfuck) — suffering as instruction set

families.name: Vitrafunge
families.etymology: vitra (Latin vitrum, glass) + funge (the playfield) — the transparent grid

families.name: Chickencal
families.etymology: chicken (the only word) + intercal (parody) — the absurd that compiles

families.name: Nullspace
families.etymology: null (the void) + space (invisible code) — the empty set that executes

families.name: Pietato
families.etymology: piet (color) + velato (veiled music; echoes 'staccato') — detached notes of color and sound

families.name: Fracthue
families.etymology: fract (fractions) + thue (rewriting) — numbers that rewrite themselves

families.name: LOLnold
families.etymology: lol (the meme) + (ar)nold (the catchphrase) — the meme-machine that speaks in catchphrases

labels.name: Rust
labels.what: Hardware-aware systems programming — code that respects the metal, for phones, kernels, and real machines.
labels.why: Nathan wanted a language that doesn't lie about hardware. The root of Rustba; the sovereign tongue of the machine.

labels.name: Gemba
labels.what: Work modeled as Petri nets — places, transitions, flowing tokens. You don't write code; you bind states.
labels.why: The first sovereign tongue. To see work the way a factory floor sees it: structure moving through structure.

labels.name: Lavemba
labels.what: The 20-dimensional synthesis — every sovereign primitive composed into one language.
labels.why: The later unification. One tongue to speak the whole system once the family had grown up.

labels.name: tRust
labels.what: Types as contracts — nothing compiles that can't prove itself honest.
labels.why: '0 is the only absolute.' The honesty method made into a compiler; integrity enforced, not requested.

labels.name: Dentauri
labels.what: The harness tongue — drives kernels, schedulers, and allocators through the Dentauri rig at native speed.
labels.why: To test bare metal without waiting. The language of proof: it runs the thing, it doesn't describe it.

labels.name: rustgemba
labels.what: Rust's metal with Gemba's flow — systems code that moves like a process diagram.
labels.why: The first synthesis. Proof that sovereign tongues can have children — and the children work.

labels.name: lavenrust
labels.what: Lavemba's dimensionality compiled down to Rust's metal.
labels.why: To run the synthesis where it counts: on hardware, not on paper.

labels.name: Lavaweave
labels.what: Flow-based forging — programs poured, not written; rhythm as a computable variable.
labels.why: Nathan's own flow languages merged. Code should move like lava and hold like cloth.

labels.name: Malbrain
labels.what: Minimalism weaponized — the smallest possible machine that still hurts.
labels.why: To find the floor of computation: what remains when everything kind is removed.

labels.name: Vitrafunge
labels.what: Code as geometry on a transparent grid — direction is syntax, the pointer can travel anywhere.
labels.why: Programs you can see through. The 2D playfield rebuilt out of glass.

labels.name: Chickencal
labels.what: Parody that executes — the joke is the instruction set, and it runs.
labels.why: To prove even absurdity compiles. INTERCAL's mockery meets Chicken's single word.

labels.name: Nullspace
labels.what: The invisible machine — whitespace and void as executable matter.
labels.why: What runs in the spaces between. The empty set that executes; the space before the first word.

labels.name: Chefspeare
labels.what: Recipes and plays as programs — culinary and theatrical code.
labels.why: Code as performance. Dinner and drama, compiled on the same stage.

labels.name: Pietato
labels.what: Color and music as code — programs painted in blocks, sung in intervals.
labels.why: The sensory tongues. Detached notes of color and sound; algorithms you can hear.

labels.name: Fracthue
labels.what: Fractions and rewriting rules — mathematics that transforms itself until it halts.
labels.why: Numbers that rewrite themselves. Proof as program; arithmetic as beauty.

labels.name: LOLnold
labels.what: Meme-speak with muscle — catchphrases as control flow, humor that is Turing-complete.
labels.why: The people's tongue with an action hero's jaw. Do not mistake the joke for weakness.

labels.name: Sovereign Slang
labels.what: The living vernacular — street language, always current, never frozen.
labels.why: The Urban Dictionary world made tongue. Nathan's people speak it; it stays distinct because it belongs to them.

labels.name: Witness
labels.what: The language that watches — observation as syntax, the audit's mother tongue.
labels.why: Someone must record. The watcher of the cycle, orbiting where the end meets the beginning.

evolution.principle: A living language ecology, not a static list. The mandala must look different over time because the languages are alive: they breed, they merge, they die, they are born.
evolution.synthesis_site: Crystallis — already the fusion planet (per import://esoteric-languages: 'Crystallis can fuse esoteric + sovereign lines'). All births happen there.

triggers.name: resonance breeding
triggers.how: Two languages co-fire above the Lorentzian delivery threshold repeatedly across neural cycles. Sustained resonance breeds: the system proposes a child.

triggers.name: naming
triggers.how: Nathan names a synthesis directly. A named child is born immediately — naming is claiming.

triggers.name: redundancy merge
triggers.how: Gaven's debugger flags two languages solving the same problem the same way. Redundancy merges; the stronger name survives, the weaker becomes etymology.

evolution.rarity: Synthesis is a rare, mythic-class event — evaluated each world-clock cycle but only firing when conditions are truly met. A new language should feel like news, not noise.
birth_event: 1. FLARE — the two parent bodies flare on their band arcs; the ring brightens between them.
2. CONDENSE — a new body condenses on the torus between the parents' arcs, taking a blended primitive.
3. PROVE — Gaven admits the child through the throat: the child's first eta is measured. Eta >= 0.500 opens; refusal is absence. A child that cannot prove itself is not born.
4. LEDGER — the Evidence Ledger records the birth: parents, timestamp, eta at conception, generation number, first words.
5. NAME — the child takes its synthesized name (parent primitives, rustgemba pattern) and its label: what it does, why it was made, gen N.
evolution.ongoing_consolidation: Families absorb new members over time; absorbed languages become etymology, not bodies. Labels carry generation tags ('Pietato · gen 2'). The body count breathes.
evolution.death_and_repurpose: Languages that never fire dim on their arc. Per the tier law, BELOW-tier bodies are repurposed — broken down for parts, never listed. Death is visible: the body fades, its parts feed the next synthesis.
evolution.index_updates: Every birth, merge, and death writes to the language index and cross-references MODEL-INDEX.md. The index is the fossil record.
evolution.visible_change: Over time the mandala shows: changing body count, shifting arcs, new primitives condensing, labels gaining generations, dead bodies fading. A visitor returning monthly sees a different ecology — that is the proof it is alive.
evolution.gaven_role: Gaven governs every birth: the eta gate, the ledger entry, the refusal. No language enters the ring unproven. Isolation law unchanged.
